# Tuya TV Viewer v0.11.0 beta 5: HD and audio

Beta 5 shows only four full-screen previews with a visible focus border and remote navigation. Selecting a camera requests the main HD stream with audio; Back returns to four silent SD streams. Supports H.264 and H.265/MP4 playback through the EU portal path, with SD fallback if the HD decoder cannot play. Automatic username/password login is unchanged. Requires Android 7 / API 24; Fire OS 5 and Vega OS are not supported. Real TV verification was still needed. Debug-signed manual test build.
